target_customer: Online publishers and video platforms (for example Vice, GQ, Le Monde) that want viewers to watch more video
problem: Publishers struggle to keep readers watching video on their own sites. Pulpix offered personalized video streams, recommendations and a picture-in-picture player.

founders.name: Sabry Otmani
founders.background_notes: YC bio: entrepreneur in science and entertainment.

founders.name: Denis Vilar
founders.background_notes: No bio on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Recommendation models plus an embeddable player integrated into publisher sites. Standard ML engineering with integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Publisher integrations gave some stickiness but recommendation widgets were widely available.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it in a documented way. A native ad platform, Adyoulike, acquired it in March 2018.

market_need_then: Business Insider India reported in beta that Pulpix helped 30 partners including Vice, GQ and Le Monde lift video views by an average of 20 percent.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline: binge-watching technology for video platforms

brand_strength.rationale: Some trade press (AdExchanger, Business Insider India) but no brand-specific coverage or community.

outcome_analysis: Pulpix raised about $850K in January 2017 on the back of publisher traction and was acquired by Adyoulike in March 2018 with undisclosed terms, so the exit came about 14 months after the seed. Reported total funding was roughly $1 million and the team was about 15 people. It looks like a small strategic exit where the buyer wanted the recommendation technology for native video ads.
